item.title: Minor Flood Warning for Warrego River downstream of Charleville, Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge and Warrego River at Rocky
item.description: Minor flooding is occurring along the lower Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge and estimated to be occurring at Rocky.The Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge was at 6.65 m at 5:45 am Friday and slowly falling, with minor flooding. The Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge is likely to remain above the minor flood level (6.00 m) through to early next week.The Warrego River at Rocky is estimated to have peaked around the moderate flood level on Wednesday, based on upstream peaks. No current river level observations are available for the Warrego River at Rocky, however it is estimated to be slowly falling with minor flooding. The Warrego River at Rocky is likely to remain above the minor flood level (2.50 m) through to early next week.
